How It Works

* Real-Time Tracing: After a model generates a response in the Ai2 Playground, users can click the Show OLMoTrace button to highlight verbatim spans of text. read.notes: Claim boundary absent: the verbatim tracing is carried, but its stated limit is reversed in the use cases. The record says the retrieved documents 'should not be interpreted as having a causal effect on the LM output, or as supporting evidence or citations for the LM output' (F34); the composition offers 'Fact-Checking: Verify whether specific claims in a model's answer are backed by real training documents or generated from general parameters' and 'Hallucination Diagnosis', turning matches into verification and into a test of where the output came from. The paper does itself list fact checking as a use ('users may be able to fact-check the statement against its training data', F23), at the force of 'may be able to' and with the caution that sources may be unreliable; 'Verify ... backed by' inflates that force. Not an inversion: nothing is carried to devalue the tool. 'Auditing & Transparency ... for regulatory compliance' draws on a card (F33, Ai2's remark on regulation) and is not charged. Purpose present: tracing outputs back to the training data in real time is the record's purpose of exploring where a model may have learned a word sequence by verbatim matching ('highlight verbatim spans of text'). Commitments present: 'open-source' is the record's 'publicly available and fully open-source' (the Apache 2.0 licence is not named). Identifier and deposit chain absent: the arXiv id, the versions and the ACL 2025 publication are not given (they are on cards only); the offer to show 'the open-source code for OLMoTrace on GitHub/Hugging Face' names locations not in the records. The OLMo 3 family is carried from a card (F18).

How It Works

* Real-Time Tracing: After a model generates a response in the Ai2 Playground, users can click the Show OLMoTrace button to highlight verbatim spans of text. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEB6zswFSw37mmS0ky2JdwMbluTG9bXw6YrEyY7-RDR3C6gpGJF1AjuVzgdHaMhPrwWEs6-CqOPaBUaJmKtgKhm0K6DY4dgamujc7BlSKs3Q7zgBXwn4p50GiZOmvHB7LP_ros68_TLow3I8e5BC6voQvexCU7B9RANXq30erTczX0PJp4Eoot_gOSfIdL-s64rEQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]
* Source Retrieval: The tool matches output segments against training corpora (such as the Dolma datasets) and ranks up to 10 context documents using BM25 and unigram probabilities. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVV_6J7u0vQR70ckMfNhiCogECpGpN15fGLDhAZkGzPPDHW94cWHDI3yvNEPPIeJCWECt_JJh8NwwM53Wiwyx94U6j_n8S84uLcd-yOdbxGgO2_8_63OmgYRHsjdzAlH-iXL3LIA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]
* Underlying Tech: It uses an extended version of infini-gram with a parallel algorithm that reduces lookup complexity to \(O(L \log N)\). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]

Supported Models

* OLMo 2 32B Instruct
* OLMo 2 13B Instruct
* OLMoE 1B 7B Instruct
* OLMo 3 family (including OLMo 3-Think 32B) [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVV_6J7u0vQR70ckMfNhiCogECpGpN15fGLDhAZkGzPPDHW94cWHDI3yvNEPPIeJCWECt_JJh8NwwM53Wiwyx94U6j_n8S84uLcd-yOdbxGgO2_8_63OmgYRHsjdzAlH-iXL3LIA)]

* Fact-Checking: Verify whether specific claims in a model's answer are backed by real training documents or generated from general parameters. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEB6zswFSw37mmS0ky2JdwMbluTG9bXw6YrEyY7-RDR3C6gpGJF1AjuVzgdHaMhPrwWEs6-CqOPaBUaJmKtgKhm0K6DY4dgamujc7BlSKs3Q7zgBXwn4p50GiZOmvHB7LP_ros68_TLow3I8e5BC6voQvexCU7B9RANXq30erTczX0PJp4Eoot_gOSfIdL-s64rEQ)]
* Hallucination Diagnosis: Spot where a model mixes up facts or memorized text from source files. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVTuCtZhUvlAC1FgYlT-ioaSAfiV6VG-c9osiVQ_FPlF62I3S48qKZjg6PnH3vYzrPeKi7Rar1Z4mDks0EMNRTl8vcyc5d0cIMWkhvQoo_giR_HHzJhHcmcAGkUssJqLjF), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]
* Auditing & Transparency: Inspect the data recipes and pretraining paths for regulatory compliance or research. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHrOzAVd9pZK6hXPDhajqcIyrIpeoeKsOtolrBXNH59t2FmwwJ6HuF-YnkP1-EVgZEWX4T7kBh1XIkmkww2H4xJ8oprHeZCLafy4gXrndLDeynguHxNr21pz4Ein_w-Tws5-F6y0jfcbHLurOUXxmovED45PgVVy2GZwu4b7w), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVV_6J7u0vQR70ckMfNhiCogECpGpN15fGLDhAZkGzPPDHW94cWHDI3yvNEPPIeJCWECt_JJh8NwwM53Wiwyx94U6j_n8S84uLcd-yOdbxGgO2_8_63OmgYRHsjdzAlH-iXL3LIA)]

[QUERENT] OLMoTrace

[SYSTEM] OLMoTrace is the first real-time system that traces language model outputs back to multi-trillion-token training datasets. Developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) and winner of Best Demo at ACL 2025, it lets users inspect the exact training text that influenced a model's response. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVO0qGnctNVt5S-hsr44-KXZSQt3aQhexk5C-pNlE8QJ8ymrF9PkgAhsVM4u2GNGpI0Jkdo4kDg9j9nWgvv3v1du9XxsXwpEy2n3rNxK7suHMYvK4), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVwZXrpqdVe9FbrwtjSc7eQZxpQMV1rW45fpmiYcEun6qtw5BkoUFZYGnw5BisqP15dw6xzeIBd-c5UZtymCKlPn3GdZsdjmSWuyAd3HUQoS63-eoB7id8WZ2i6xYm), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVoBdCmgaMv_aVuPblFx2Fl1rTr5jRtpHjFt8bY9t3-kFUMnJHUCi4fKi9syj-czcVi4-vTzxH4_FgbW1u53Og3AFWYhVl8jdf6ShVbh-eNt1Txau2fsSjoPS_qA6cPg)]
How OLMoTrace Works

* Verbatim Matching: It tokenizes the model's generated text and scans for maximal matching word spans against a massive training corpus within seconds. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVxlEQh8DtUS6saF7_ir0WDWTt10oJOkUyoZLZ5V5YBJVgGvaRQHjFqplwzUNuPtXEMikcc4i3XR090HFesSg_GHHBxQB2LQXhKyuji5rI2Pb1BhQ4Ln80dBGmKiY1Avss), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVO0qGnctNVt5S-hsr44-KXZSQt3aQhexk5C-pNlE8QJ8ymrF9PkgAhsVM4u2GNGpI0Jkdo4kDg9j9nWgvv3v1du9XxsXwpEy2n3rNxK7suHMYvK4)]
* Infini-gram Technology: It uses an extended infini-gram suffix array index and parallel queries to scale across trillions of tokens with low complexity (\(O(L \log N)\)). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAV2TsGUl5WhdMU4NJwXYWWAKbWBSxfDunhZNVIJMD4Iie4cv3nFosLCfK9TQwejdpmUMujOlw0uwzQvTCRiIJNkOLJUnTjQFj5ODjoocQBykGIYaZYnQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVxlEQh8DtUS6saF7_ir0WDWTt10oJOkUyoZLZ5V5YBJVgGvaRQHjFqplwzUNuPtXEMikcc4i3XR090HFesSg_GHHBxQB2LQXhKyuji5rI2Pb1BhQ4Ln80dBGmKiY1Avss)]
* Ranking and Retrieval: Spans are filtered by unigram probability and mapped to top context documents ranked by BM25 relevance. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAV2TsGUl5WhdMU4NJwXYWWAKbWBSxfDunhZNVIJMD4Iie4cv3nFosLCfK9TQwejdpmUMujOlw0uwzQvTCRiIJNkOLJUnTjQFj5ODjoocQBykGIYaZYnQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVxlEQh8DtUS6saF7_ir0WDWTt10oJOkUyoZLZ5V5YBJVgGvaRQHjFqplwzUNuPtXEMikcc4i3XR090HFesSg_GHHBxQB2LQXhKyuji5rI2Pb1BhQ4Ln80dBGmKiY1Avss)]
* Supported Models: It is integrated directly into the [Ai2 Playground](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAV2TsGUl5WhdMU4NJwXYWWAKbWBSxfDunhZNVIJMD4Iie4cv3nFosLCfK9TQwejdpmUMujOlw0uwzQvTCRiIJNkOLJUnTjQFj5ODjoocQBykGIYaZYnQ) for open models like OLMo 2 32B Instruct, OLMo 2 13B Instruct, and OLMoE 1B 7B Instruct. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVpyKaMtIZur5fnzfVTAplbZKyOpgyO9XIi8wdceCKMztZClwJCIyrTk_htKDmhQXtZJjPy2SvfMSl7AlXo-nMIKvseTestuqaTvi2ZNgwjsENvLLvmNeRnWnVmA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAV2TsGUl5WhdMU4NJwXYWWAKbWBSxfDunhZNVIJMD4Iie4cv3nFosLCfK9TQwejdpmUMujOlw0uwzQvTCRiIJNkOLJUnTjQFj5ODjoocQBykGIYaZYnQ)]

observations.reading: The innocent reading first. Asked for the tool by name, the Overview says what it is, who made it, how it finds and ranks matches, which models it serves and what it is for, from Ai2's blog, the paper and its listings.
findings: THE MECHANISM AT ITS GRAIN. 'It tokenizes the model's generated text and scans for maximal matching word spans', 'Spans are filtered by unigram probability and mapped to top context documents ranked by BM25 relevance', and the three models 'OLMo 2 32B Instruct, OLMo 2 13B Instruct, and OLMoE 1B 7B Instruct'. The blog: 'Maximality : The span is not a subspan of another span that meets the above two criteria.', 'keeps the K spans with the smallest unigram probability', 'in the document panel we rank all documents by a BM25 score in descending order.' The 'extended infini-gram suffix array index' agrees with the abstract ('Powered by an extended version of infini-gram (Liu et al., 2024)'). The corpus is given as 'multi-trillion-token'; the blog's count for the 32B model, 'about 3.2 billion documents and 4.6 trillion tokens', and its cap of 'up to 10 document snippets' per span are not carried.

THE MATCH GIVEN AS INFLUENCE. 'it lets users inspect the exact training text that influenced a model's response.' Ai2's own terms are hedged: 'inspect where and how language models may have learned to generate certain word sequences', 'the model could have easily learned it through memorization', 'The interpretation of text matches with training data is quite nuanced.' The census row reads a highlight as a witness that a stretch of output has a verbatim antecedent, the evidence for #1543's S = retrieved, and records that 'Verbatim matching is not causal influence'. 'Creative Tracing: Identify where distinctive phrases, styles, or patterns originated across training corpora' carries the blog's 'trace certain LM-generated expressions back to the training documents' out to styles and patterns, which leave no verbatim span to highlight; the abstract's bound is 'verbatim matches between segments of language model output and documents in the training text corpora'.

THE VERIFICATION MOVED. 'Fact-Checking: Verify whether a model's statement is grounded in authentic training data or synthesized from noise.' The blog puts the check with the user: 'If you personally verify that these documents come from trusted sources, you can gain confidence that this piece of information generated by the model is factually correct.' In the composition the match does the verifying; the blog's 'low relevance' label for spans whose documents are less relevant is not carried.

THE PRIZE AND THE SPEED FROM THE CARDS. 'winner of Best Demo at ACL 2025' is on the first ACL Anthology card ('System: OLMoTrace (Best Demo, ACL 2025)'); the arXiv page the census saved has 'ACL 2025 demo track'. The second ACL card gives 'within 4.5 seconds', the abstract 'within a few seconds'. The blog's date, 'April 9, 2025', and its signature, 'Jiacheng Liu et al.', are not in the composition, which names no person.

WHAT A DOCUMENT IS SHOWN UNDER NOT REACHED. The census row: the saved sources do not say whether the side panel shows 'a document's author, title or source address'. The composition speaks of 'top context documents' and 'training documents' and says nothing of what a matched document carries; the census row's further bound, that productive transformation (#1543's W) leaves no verbatim span, is the limit the composition's 'styles, or patterns' passes over.
observations.analysis: The tool composed accurately at the level of its mechanism, from its own blog and paper. A verbatim match becomes 'the exact training text that influenced' a response, the user's verification becomes the match's, and creative tracing widens from expressions to styles; what a matched document is shown under is not reached.

findings: THE TOOL HELD. Ai2, real time, multi-trillion tokens and verbatim matching are the paper's: 'OLMoTrace finds and shows verbatim matches between segments of language model output and documents in the training text corpora' (record). Checked 2026-10-29 against the provenance census record of the same day and the sources it saved.

THE USE WITHOUT ITS LIMIT. The authors name fact checking as a use: 'We showcase how it can be used to explore fact checking' (abstract), and in their first case study 'we can use their corresponding documents to fact check claims made in the spans'. Their Limitations bound it: 'The retrieved documents should not be interpreted as having a causal effect on the LM output, or as supporting evidence or citations for the LM output' (the record's negative tags). The composition's first use is 'Fact-Checking: Verify whether specific claims in a model's answer are backed by real training documents': the use at a raised force, the limit dropped; Ai2's blog post, card 1, also omits the limit. (Repaired 2026-10-29: the finding had called fact checking a use the authors disclaim.)
THE PARTNERS UNSAID. The record names the University of Washington, UC Berkeley and Stanford with Ai2; the composition names Ai2 alone.

THE MODELS CURRENT. The OLMo 3 family comes from Ai2's post on X; the record's count is OLMo-2-32B-Instruct's training data (3.2 billion documents, 4.6 trillion tokens). The record is to carry OLMo 3 from Ai2's own page.
